description: Consolidated acceptance of Phases 146-152 backtest/benchmark/robustness block.
Enforce local and offline execution without remote service calls.
Verify dry-run compliance and contract existence across all sub-components.
Enforce non-production, research-only boundaries on all outputs.
Strict prohibition of live trading or broker order routing.
Prohibit execution of real backtesting loops or PnL generation.
Prohibit execution of real benchmark simulations or tracking error calculations.
Prohibit calculation of Sharpe, drawdown, win-rate, alpha, beta, VaR, or returns.
Prohibit strategy approval, capital allocation, portfolio construction, and position sizing.
Provide clean handoff to Phase 153 Portfolio Construction, Position Sizing and Risk Budgeting.
